frontier.hypothesis: The residual is a DECLARED 32-byte local in the shipped source shared by all four siblings; the remaining open question is whether that object is LIVE in some variant of the routine, which would make it ordinary C needing no engine allowlist row.
frontier.mechanism: function.c assign_stack_local reserves the slot from the source DECL at RTL-expand and never reclaims frame_offset; a 32-byte PsyQ-era local in a sprite-batch routine is a MATRIX or an 8-word packet/DMA staging buffer. Shape-invariance across four structurally different siblings (s8) is the declaration signature; phantom residue would vary with expression shape.
frontier.next_probe: Survey the rest of the shipped binary for a fifth/sixth member of this routine family (other batch loaders that call func_800482C8 or its neighbours) and check whether any of them WRITES the 0x18-0x37 window - a live sibling names the object and gives an honest, row-free C form for all four. `grep -l 'jal.*func_800482C8' asm/funcs/*.s` is the entry point, then framecensus.py on each hit.
